title: TopAgent
description_en: Drive B2B event attendance with an AI agent. Fill your next B2B conference, summit, or workshop with SMS invitations and relevant follow-ups. Give TopAgent your opted-in audience, event details, registration link, and deadline. It prepares the campaign, monitors delivery, clicks, and replies, and returns with follow-ups ready for your approval.

title: MCP Server by XWiki
description_en: Give your AI your wiki's knowledge while keeping the control. XWiki MCP Server is an open-source, self-hostable extension that connects XWiki to the AI agent of your choice: OpenCode, Pi, Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and more. You can already use the extension to query your knowledge base to get answers, create and edit pages, and work with structured data directly in XWiki. Try out the extension and let us what's should we improve next!

title: Canva Brush
description_en: Canva Brush: a vision-language model that edits your designs. Canva Brush is a vision-language model for design from Canva Research. It sees your design, understands how it’s put together, and makes the changes you ask for, from one line of copy to every slide in a deck. Everything stays fully editable. Canva says it’s up to 69% faster and 46% lower cost per edit task than its previous design agent. It’s powering Canva AI design edits for Canva Pro subscribers today.

title: Radar
description_en: You don't need an AI SRE. Give your agent Radar.. Your agent knows Kubernetes. It doesn't know your cluster. Radar (open-source) gives it context over MCP: ranked issues, a change timeline, logs and owners in one view. New: click Investigate on a failing workload. Claude Code, Codex or Cursor finds the root cause, read-only, with evidence for each claim. In our benchmark of 50 live faults across six tools, Radar found the most root causes. Radar Cloud investigates every alert and posts findings to Slack.

title: IFTTT.ai
description_en: The easiest way to automate anything. IFTTT is now IFTTT.ai, and every plan now includes our core features and all 1,000+ services, from multiple actions and filters to queries and Webhooks. Pricing is credit-based, and you can build unlimited Applets for free. AI got an upgrade too. AI Agent watches web pages for price changes or new listings, AI Action assist writes each action based on its trigger, and AI queries run on better models. Or describe an automation in IFTTT Chat and it builds the Applet for you.

title: Viggle JST-2
description_en: JST-2: 3D scenes, characters and motion from one model. JST-2 is Viggle’s physics-native world foundation model for generating 3D scenes, characters and full-body motion in one shared world. Scenes take about one second, characters come from one image or text with motion built in, and motion comes from text or video. Try it free in the PINOC browser app, or use the API or MCP with agents like Claude Code. Benchmarks are Viggle’s own blind human tests.

title: Chopstick
description_en: Mac activity and action widgets that write themselves. Chopstick notices what you repeat on your Mac and builds notch widgets for it, using the coding agent you already have. Your activity log stays local.

title: Intrascope 2.0
description_en: New AI agent, 1,650+ apps, Skills and smart model routing. What's different: ChatGPT and Claude lock you into one vendor. Intrascope 2.0 gives your team 120+ models (GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen) plus an AI agent that works in 1,650+ apps like Gmail, Slack, Drive and Notion. The company stays in control: admins approve apps and models, set budgets per team, project and person, and see every token and dollar. New in 2.0: agent, connectors, Skills, Auto routing, full redesign. Private and on-prem deployments for enterprise.

title: fastbrowse
description_en: Fastest open source browser agent. A fast open-source browser agent. It reads every button, link and field on the page and has a System One model (ex: jev) pick the next step from that list. If it's unsure, it falls back to a standard model model. Fast, cheap, and every answer provides a citation.

title: Teable Mobile
description_en: Build the systems your team runs on, now from your phone. Explain your process like you would to a new hire. Teable builds the database, the app and the automations, so the work stops living in your head. Now you can do it from your phone: hold to talk, publish to your team, and get notified when it's done.

title: Voxel51 Multimodal
description_en: Better data. Smarter robots. Repeat.. The real world is messy. Robots encounter unexpected situations and behave in ways you never anticipated. But every failure is a chance to teach your robot something new. The hard part? Sifting through hours of video and sensor data to figure out why your robot failed. Voxel51 is an end-to-end multimodal data platform that accelerates robot learning. Find the failures that matter, understand why they happened, and fill gaps in your training data to improve models faster. Try Voxel51 for free.

title: JIMMY
description_en: JIMMY is an AI agent that runs on your PC. JIMMY runs on your Windows PC and listens to your WhatsApp self-chat. Text "send the resume in Downloads to Rahul" or "screenshot" and it does the task, asks before sending anything, and replies. Scheduled tasks, custom commands, /stop and an undo log included.

title: Faylee
description_en: Bug reports your coding agent can fix from one link. Faylee records the screen, console, every network request and each click behind a bug, on one timeline, and shares it all as one link. Your team opens it and sees exactly what broke, with the failing request already open. Paste the link into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and Faylee's MCP server gives the agent the whole report so it can find the cause and fix it. Instant replay saves the last few minutes after a bug already happened. Free for up to 3 members.

title: Suno MCP
description_en: The music layerfor your AI stack. MCP stands for Model Context Protocol, an open standard that lets AI assistants work with other apps. The Suno MCP connects your Suno account to the AI assistants you already use, like ChatGPT and Claude. Once it’s connected, you can ask your assistant to make a song, extend it, cover it, and more, right in the conversation you’re already having! Your assistant can use everything you’ve already discussed (lyrics, a project, a video plan) so you don’t have to re-explain your idea.

title: SparkBots AI (Powered by Jev)
description_en: Instantly extract key details and analyze any webpage or PDF. SparkBots can be trained to deeply analyze any web page or PDF. Once trained, your Sparkbot can be run on similar pages returning answers in less than a second. Perfect for analyzing and extracting key details for leads, businesses, resumes, listings, contracts or any PDF. SparkBot use AI, but it isn't a slow LLM like Claude or ChatGPT. It can't hallucinate or make up details that don't exist. Every answer comes straight from the content on the page and anything it doesn't find is left blank.

title: Smart Jelly
description_en: Your everyday AI tools and memory in one Mac app.. One app for dictation, live meeting help, Pre meeting notes, Notetaker, Track open loops and agents, all sharing one memory of you. No need to pay for five AI tools that each start from zero. Every feature knows your work and gets smarter as you use it.

title: Cluinn
description_en: Answers your questions during the call, not after. For Mac.. Someone asks a question on a call and you need the answer now. Cluinn listens on your Mac and answers mid-call from what was just said, with no bot joining the meeting. Smart Cards flag a question nobody answered. When the call ends you get the action items, and Coach shows how the call went against a goal you set. It also does AI dictation: speak, and clean text lands in any Mac app. For Apple silicon Macs. 14-day trial; LAUNCH30 takes 30% off for 12 months.

title: ilse
description_en: Point at your app and your AI agent changes the code. Ilse puts a toolbar on top of the React app you already have running. Click an element and say what should change, drag to reorder, resize, or tweak spacing and colors with your project's own tokens. Simple tweaks land instantly, with no AI. The rest goes to the agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini), pointing at the right spot in the code. Pro adds test mode: Ilse walks real user journeys on her own and reports what breaks.

title: AutoShelf 2.6
description_en: Automate any folder on your Mac with if-this-then-that rules. AutoShelf is a Mac app that automatically files, renames, tags, converts, and sorts new files in folders like Downloads and Desktop, based on rules you set once. New: sort into subfolders built from tokens like %kind% and %date%, unarchive, Finder color labels, and rules that cover all or selected subfolders. Free with 1 rule, or $19.99 one-time for unlimited rules ($29.99 from Nov 25). Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

title: MAO
description_en: Team up Claude Code, Codex and Grok on one canvas. Put Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and Grok on one canvas and let them work as a team. Wire two agents and they talk, delegate and hand back results while you lead. Native on macOS, Linux and Windows, built in Rust. 7-day free trial, no card. Then $20, once.

title: StoreLocale
description_en: Translate app UI in App Store & Google Play screenshots. Localize the UI inside App Store and Google Play screenshots. Review results in the editor, then export PNGs grouped by store, language, and size. The editor is free; use your own Gemini or OpenRouter API key, or buy one-time credits for AI image generation.

title: Kin
description_en: The AI labs want to own you. Make them answer to you.. Let your AIs run free. Kin keeps them in check. Connect GitHub, Gmail or Stripe once, add Kin to ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor, and give each action a rule: Allow, Ask me or Block. Ask me waits for your OK on the web or your phone.
